hotspots.title: Trump-Putin Diesel Deal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Senators and media are erupting over President Trump's new diesel purchase agreement with Russia, condemning it as a betrayal and a dangerous lifeline to Moscow while framing it as a catastrophic policy.
hotspots.affect: The story fuels polarized outrage and moral panic, with bipartisan lawmakers demanding reversal and commentators warning of national security fallout.

hotspots.title: Taxpayer‑Funded Pro‑Trump TV Ads Halted
hotspots.blurb: Federal judges across the country have ordered the Trump administration to stop airing promotional television ads funded by taxpayers, labeling them illegal political propaganda and sparking a legal showdown.
hotspots.affect: The injunctions trigger fierce debates over government misuse of funds, evoking accusations of corruption and a fight over free speech versus electoral fairness.

hotspots.title: Trump Rally Violence & Outbursts
hotspots.blurb: Recent Trump rallies have been marred by a protester being assaulted, a bizarre physical commentary about a senator, and a viral compliment incident, highlighting escalating tensions at campaign events.
hotspots.affect: The incidents amplify outrage and alarm, portraying the rallies as volatile hotspots of confrontation and sensational behavior.

hotspots.title: FrP Surge Among Young Women
hotspots.blurb: Norway's Progress Party (FrP) is experiencing a rapid rise in support among young female voters, narrowing the traditional gender gap and prompting internal debates about the party’s direction.
hotspots.affect: The surge creates intra‑party tension and fuels a broader cultural narrative about right‑wing parties reshaping gender dynamics.
